plainTranslation:
There's real attraction here, but it may not feel simple. One person might move forward while the other pulls back, and that back-and-forth can become part of the chemistry. The distance creates heat, but it can also make the relationship feel like something always has to be chased.

At its best, this keeps things exciting. At its worst, both people start confusing tension with connection. One person may feel rejected, while the other feels pressured.

Failure mode: only feeling the romance when there is friction, distance, or someone to win over. Once things get simple, the connection may start looking for a new problem.

Say what you want directly. Don't make the other person figure it out from hints, timing, or attitude.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
